en_title: Nolan North Is Staying in Shape Just in Case Sony Calls About Uncharted 5
cn_title: Nolan North为《神秘海域5》回归保持身材
subtitle: 就等一通电话
opus_summary: 据报道，《神秘海域》系列新作正在开发，但索尼尚未正式公布。主角内森·德雷克的扮演者Nolan North表示，若收到邀请，他很乐意回归，并一直保持身材，以备接到电话；他目前尚未听到新作消息。

paragraphs.en: Uncharted star Nolan North is keen to return for Uncharted 5, amid reports that a fresh entry in the franchise is in production .
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《神秘海域》系列新作正在开发。曾出演该系列的Nolan North表示，他很希望在《神秘海域5》中回归。

paragraphs.en: While Sony is yet to officially announce any new Uncharted project, Naughty Dog has confirmed it has multiple games in the works right now. Aside from the upcoming Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet, it is believed that Uncharted: The Lost Legacy director Shaun Escayg is leading a team building a fresh entry in the company's beloved adventure series.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼尚未正式公布任何《神秘海域》新项目，但顽皮狗已确认，目前有多款游戏正在开发。除了即将推出的《Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet》，据称《神秘海域：失落的遗产》总监Shaun Escayg也正带领团队开发这一广受喜爱的冒险系列新作。

paragraphs.en: North, who portrays Uncharted hero Nathan Drake, has now said he would happily return to the role if asked — and has even tried to stay in shape for whenever the call comes. Perhaps unsurprisingly, North is also bullish on Uncharted 5's likelihood of success if it is indeed released — while also acknowledging that Naughty Dog needed to avoid launching something as unpopular as the fourth Indiana Jones movie, Kingdom of the Crystal Skull.
paragraphs.cn: North在《神秘海域》中饰演主角内森·德雷克。他表示，如果收到邀请，自己很乐意再演这个角色，甚至一直努力保持身材，等着那通电话。North还看好《神秘海域5》若能推出后的表现，但也认为顽皮狗得避免做出像第四部《夺宝奇兵》电影《夺宝奇兵4：水晶骷髅王国》那样不受欢迎的作品。

paragraphs.en: "I think it would be one of the biggest games ever if they decided to do it," North said, speaking during the Gamergy show in Puerto Rico (thanks, DomTheBomb / VGC ). "It just depends if Sony wants to make money.
paragraphs.cn: North在波多黎各的Gamergy活动上说：「如果他们决定做，我觉得它会成为有史以来最轰动的游戏之一。这就看索尼想不想赚钱了。」

paragraphs.en: "I haven't heard anything, but you know, it is a business and my God, can you imagine if they if they did? I mean, it would be the biggest announcement in gaming. And I don’t think that’s hyperbole, I think that's true. I think that would be... to bring back a storied franchise like that? You just don't want to make a Kingdom of the Crystal Skull."
paragraphs.cn: 「我还没听到任何消息。但你知道，这毕竟是生意。天哪，你能想象他们真做了会怎样吗？我的意思是，那会是游戏界最轰动的消息。我不觉得这话夸张，我觉得就是这样。要让这么一个历史悠久的系列回归……你肯定不想做出一部《夺宝奇兵4：水晶骷髅王国》。」

paragraphs.en: While Intergalactic is believed to be the next project to launch from Naughty Dog, the studio still has a legion of fans keen for new entries in its other franchises: The Last of Us and Uncharted. It's now been a decade since Uncharted 4 released and put a nice bow on Nathan Drake's adventures, but this gap in time also opens up the possibility of a fresh adventure that featured his daughter, Cassie.
paragraphs.cn: 外界认为，顽皮狗接下来推出的作品会是《Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet》，但仍有大批粉丝期待《最后生还者》和《神秘海域》推出新作。《神秘海域4》发售至今已有十年，德雷克的冒险也在那部作品中圆满收尾。不过，时隔这么久，也为让他的女儿凯西成为新冒险的主角提供了可能。

paragraphs.en: "You know, I try to stay in shape, just in case," Nolan concluded. "It was 10 years of work with good friends, good people, a great developer. I can't see a scenario that I would say no."
paragraphs.cn: Nolan最后说：「你知道，我一直努力保持身材，以防万一。那是我与好友、好伙伴和一家出色的开发商共同工作的十年。我想不出自己有什么理由拒绝。」
